note: The range's selection as data, under page-platform S1 (records from sturij-assets, files by id). It names no decor: it names registry rows by id and the rule that places a decor in a tab. scripts/materials-feed.mjs joins this to the registry snapshot and emits public/materials.json, which the strip, the collector and the calculator read. A decor the registry does not hold cannot appear here; it is a misfit for the registry (IS v2's asset migration), listed below so the feed can report it.

registry.store: the registry's material_images.storage_path is a path in this repository's public folder — the showcase directory the record names as the image store (745e6fe7)
registry.read_key: STURIJ_ASSETS_READ_KEY — a read-only key held in the vault by name; STURIJ_ASSETS_URL beside it. Never the service-role key; never a value in this repository.

families.note: Egger's decor code grammar: the first letter of the code says the family. A rule on the supplier's own data, declared once here — not a decor named in code.

decors.placed: by the handoff (README §3) — the registry row carries no decor code and no measurement, so the family cannot be read from it

handles.note: The handle finishes. The registry holds handle products (Hendel & Hendel 80, Häfele 449) but no finish record: the variants' `finish` axis is a surface (gloss, matt, satin, textured) and their `colour` axis a synthetic palette. The fifteen finish names below are the handoff's, kept as data until the registry names finishes; under the finish rule (addendum 1, 11 Sep 2026) each is HELD — a labelled tile, 'sample at the visit' — until a master lands in the library at no less than 1500 px on the short side from the maker's own photography or a system render. The fifteen files in showcase/metals are procedural 1024 px swatches and are not masters.
